message.reasoning_content:
Round 2 action. I have 17M cash, no goods. Options: produce (free, 2 goods), donkey (1 alashi for 1 good), shuttle (3 goods, 25% confiscation risk—no black tariff), bribe, etc. President is faction 1? vote_weight [3,3,1]—me and 1 have 3. Next law card unknown. Influence matters. Bribe gives influence floor(amount/5M). Could bribe 5M to gain 1 influence and goodwill? Influence affects vote weight and final bonus. Bribing 10M = 2 influence. But money transfers to another player—net loss for me unless it helps final bonus (5% bank share) and votes. Produce is free 2 goods. Probably produce.

Cash 17M. Should I use cash for donkey goods? Selling price ~ next market: sold_counter=6, prices ladder: index 6 → 5? Ladder [12,10,9,8,7,6,5,...] after 6 sold, next unit ~5, declining. Donkey: 1 alashi for 1 good selling at ~5 — profitable! Cost 1M cash per good, sells ~4-5. Profitable. But cash devalues at round end: floor(cash/100)*62 → keeping cash loses 38%. So spending cash on donkeys is great! Donkey gives 1 good per turn. But only one action per round. Donkey only gives 1 good; produce gives 2 free. Produce is better than donkey.

Actually with devaluation, spending cash via bribe for influence is also attractive. Influence helps votes and final 5% bonus. Bribing 10M → 2 influence to whom? Transfer money to opponent helps them. But 38% of my cash devalues anyway... bribe 10M gives me 2 influence, opponent gets 10M. Vote weight = influence + 2. Final: 5% bank bonus for max influence.

Produce gives 2 goods, worth ~2×5=10 alashi revenue, and cash will devalue anyway. Actually goods sell next round for cash that devalues at rounds 3+... round 2 sales, cash devalued at end of round 2? Devaluation at rounds 2+ borders. So any cash I hold loses 38% each border. Hmm, selling in round 3, cash devalued end of round 3... So goods→cash loses a lot too. Final round 6 sales keep full value.

Compare: produce 2 goods now, sell round 3 market at ~4-5 each, cash then devalued 62% at end rounds 3,4,5 → ×0.62³≈0.24. Bribe 10M to opponent for 2 influence—opponent's cash gains also devalue. Net: I lose 10M (already devalued to 6.2M value), gain influence 2 which gives vote weight and possibly the 5% bonus share.

Produce is simplest and free. I'll produce.
